intro: Elevate your hair care with the 10 Years of Ayurveda Hair Care Trio, a powerful combination designed to address hair fall and promote strong, healthy growth. This kit, featuring our Keshwash Red Onion Shampoo, Hair Protein Powder, and Veda Oil, provides a complete routine to nourish your hair from the inside out. Each product is formulated with pure and natural Ayurvedic ingredients, ensuring your hair receives the best care without harsh chemicals.

Hair Protein Powder: A potent blend that strengthens hair from the roots, significantly reducing breakage. It promotes healthy hair growth and nourishes the scalp and follicles.
Veda Oil: A deeply nourishing and revitalizing oil that works to prevent hair fall and promote strong, healthy hair growth.
